description: Send an email template, filled with sample data (or one owner's data), to the user's own Spur account email from their email sender, to check it in a real inbox. Never goes to owners. Confirm with the user first.

confirm.description: Set to true ONLY after the user explicitly approved this exact action in the conversation. Never assume approval.

owner_id.description: Preview with this owner's real data (spur_find_owners) instead of sample data

sender_id.description: Email sender to send from; defaults to the user's default sender

template_id.description: Email or SMS template id (UUID from a Spur list/search tool)

name: spur_send_test_email
title: Send test email to yourself
